findings.message: FR17 / task 8.4: the plan never says how the Grid-only meeting contract scenario joins the view contract. playwright.bdd.config.ts runs every `@view-contract` scenario on every registered view (`viewContractProjects` with `grep: /@view-contract/`). Its only per-view exclusion is `VIEW_CONTRACT_PENDING_TAGS` ('The scenarios a view cannot pass yet … the tag names the change that brings the scenario back (ADR-0012)'; views.md: 'excluded for that view only, by a pending tag that names the view and the change that brings it back'), which does not fit Cards, since Cards never gets a meeting (NG4). Task 8.4 tags `grid_view_meeting_contract_e2e.feature` only `@FR17`, yet runs `--project view-contract-grid` and `--project view-contract-cards` and expects both to pass. With `@view-contract`, view-contract-cards fails. Without it, no view-contract project runs the scenario, so it is not a view-contract scenario as FR17 and the planned glossary line 'Grid also passes the meeting scenarios' claim. Add a design decision and a task for the mechanism (e.g. a view-scoped contract tag or a capability filter driven by `showsMeetingRange`, with the config, glossary View contract entry and docs/architecture/views.md updated) and make 8.4's verification match it.
